rules.requirement: Bound raw bytes to4194304 and depth32 before decode; reject malformed UTF8/BOM, duplicate or escaped duplicate keys, unpaired Unicode surrogates, trailing data, nonfinite numbers, negative zero and unsafe keys at every depth.

Times must parse and round-trip as real UTC Gregorian timestamps at exact millisecond precision; format/date annotations alone are not authority. Fresh metadata expiry is later than checkedAt and within admitted freshness policy; no clock rollback or expired next-stage authority.

Integer fields require unsigned decimal JSON integer tokens within safe bounds; reject bool,1.0,1e0,-0 and values>9007199254740991. Options may use separately admitted finite floating numbers; they are not a public digest domain.
Every record requires all named fields and rejects unknown fields. Nullable fields are explicit. Unknown protocol/version and downgrade are rejected.

Original basenames are ASCII printable1..255 with nonempty stem/extension; reject separators/:<>"|?*, leading dot/space, trailing dot/space and reserved CON/PRN/AUX/NUL/COM1..9/LPT1..9 stems, case-insensitively.
Archive paths are relative forward-slash paths; no empty/dot/dotdot segments, absolute/drive/UNC/control forms, links/special entries, duplicate/case collisions or unlisted members.

Original IDs unique; basenames unique case-insensitively; objectCount/counts/positive safe sum exact. Original order/IDs/names/hashes/byte sizes are immutable. Requested LiDAR subset is exact, genuine and positive; derived ODM cloud cannot replace it.

pipelineDigest is opaque server-approved request identity copied from authenticated original context. No caller-computed options canonicalization, float algorithm or client self-hash can establish it.
Options and vocabulary fingerprint must match the authenticated admitted engine catalog and server-approved pipeline. A schema-shaped options object is not admission.

odm_only requests one ODM stage; treedar_only requests one TreeDar stage; combined requests ODM then TreeDar under one original parent. Exact sorted products/inputs, stages/ordinals and Gaussian false must agree with original plan.

Every nested binding equals trusted original job/generation/environment/input-manifest/pipeline/parent-claim identity. Credential establishes environment/actor. Stage binding equals admitted worker/image/reservation/receipt/continuation; IDs supplied by worker are not proof.

odm_archive:zip, treedar_bundle:zip, orthophoto:geotiff, pointcloud:zip, mesh:glb, dem:geotiff, report:pdf. Exactly one positive ODM archive on ODM success and one TreeDar bundle on TreeDar success; unrequested engines produce none. No tree_inventory/CHM relabel.

A stage result has exactly that stage engine version and original products only, not both requested engines or another stage results. IDs unique/ASCII ordered; requested products match required flags and outcomes.

available has nonempty exact validated targets; failed/not_produced have no targets; not_produced optional may have null evidence. Required unavailable prevents parent completion. Every target/container/hash/size/member/closure matches its SAME stage immutable manifest. No mandatory standalone duplicate product artifact.

ZIP member references match actual admitted closure descriptor, expanded bytes/hash/path and exact dependencies. Synthetic transport bytes do not prove report/pointcloud/mesh/geospatial semantics. Plain-file targets have null closure and no members; zip products require a real agreed closure descriptor.

Original sources and physical artifacts remain positive. Zero-byte expanded EPT/archive metadata entries require explicit semantic closure/policy justification; no blanket zero allowance and no empty product/ZIP success.

ProductOutcome.evidenceReceiptId and ProductTarget.validationReceiptId refer to authenticated PREUPLOAD worker semantic validation, not future NAS ingestion acceptance. NAS accepted-copy validation is separate.

Original NAS custody is independently authenticated immutable-object/purge-pin evidence for exact original subset. Matching strings/hash/stat or claimed genuine flags alone authorize nothing. Producer result custody exists before manifest/upload and binds exact retained physical bytes.

Producer custody, NAS accepted-copy custody, acquisition, acceptance/storage/ACK and terminal receipt roles remain distinct. AcceptedArtifact.producerCustodyReceiptId is original Artifact.physicalReceiptId; its physicalReceiptId is a different managed accepted-copy receipt.

Partial acceptance references one exact binding/resultSetId/resultManifestSha256. Every accepted ID/hash/size/stage/worker/reservation matches that manifest and original producer receipt. Never union receipts from different result manifests/stages to invent closure.

NAS acceptance follows durable exact-copy byte/directory barriers and semantic validation, plus committed receipt/outbox. Upload/HTTP success alone is not acceptance. IDs must resolve through fixed authenticated trusted services.

Metadata request retains original parent/plan/stage/predecessor/acquisition/custody/objects/transfer/ledger identities; stable operation+round+intent bytes and purpose. Changed body under same key conflicts; no new round while outcome unknown.

Distinct metadata-only fixed issuer/actor authorization; do not forward expired payload bearer. Exact authenticated response binding, current custody/revocation/policy and valid bounded metadata deadline before NEXT heavy stage. No new payload permission/expiry/budget/claim.

Denied response has null expiry and exact original request bindings; no old-green fallback. Zero custody/revocation revision only with issuer_unavailable. Immutable round histories/counts/bytes remain charged through restart.

Seal authorized at-start receipt/intent/source identities before engine mutation. Later metadata TTL expiry does not invalidate truthful sealed execution/output or rewrite native bundle/source identity. Ongoing current revocation/parent policy remains separate.

Catalog/publication requires separate CURRENT authenticated publication authority and accepted product closure. Historical source admission alone cannot authorize publication after current denial/revocation. Metadata publication_authority_check is not itself a catalog publish credential.

Preissue reserve/charge exact finite rounds/attempts/canonical bytes/history/concurrency/control disk holds; retry/lookup same operation counts monotonically. Unknown issuer outcome uses exact lookup or explicitly proven identical replay; no counter reset or new key.

ALL original requested heavy stages must actually stop/settle with verified stop, custody and safe disk-budget receipts before authoritative heavy/global CPU/GPU release. Intermediate ODM alone in combined is insufficient. Requested cancel/timeouts are not stop evidence.

Execution settled/heavy released is distinct from Viewer acceptance/publication/parent delivery completion. Viewer outage retains bytes, original custody, disk/control/outbox holds while safely settled heavy capacity may release.

Parent completion requires exact original stage result references and all required products durably accepted and published. Optional unavailable outputs do not fabricate success; stage/partial/worker receipts cannot independently manufacture parent completion.

Cleanup ACK requires exact authenticated parent terminal delivery, accepted closure and pin-free producer subset. Never delete originals, accepted managed copies, unaccepted output or unknown paths; missing ACK retains data. Original-source release is a separate issuer decision.

Positive explicit per-admission archive/raw/expanded member/count/control/disk policies must account all simultaneous original, producer RAW/ZIP, transfer/expansion/accepted copies and outboxes by actual filesystem; no compressed-size substitute or reservation reset.
Canonical safe-integer metadata uses UTF8/ASCII-key sorting/no whitespace/array order; omit ONLY the designated own top-level self-digest. Never omit nested physical sha256. Only named domains apply.
Superseded v3 SourceMetadataReauthorization compact summary is excluded from root message union; full addendum receipt is required. Owners must remove or explicitly pair any future derived view.
